name: Satisfactory (Wine + Archipelago)
author: admin@hvik.org
description: Satisfactory Windows-Dedicated-Server unter Wine mit dem Archipelago-Mod (es gibt ihn nicht für Linux-Server). Wird von hvik.org gesteuert.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# HviK: Satisfactory Windows-Dedicated-Server (läuft unter Wine) + Archipelago-Mod und Abhängigkeiten (WindowsServer-Builds von ficsit.app)
apt update
apt install -y curl unzip ca-certificates lib32gcc-s1
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd && cd /mnt/server/steamcmd
curl -sSL https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz | tar xz
export HOME=/mnt/server
for n in 1 2 3; do
  ./steamcmd.sh +@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType windows +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login anonymous +app_info_update 1 +app_update 1690800 validate +quit | tee /tmp/steam.log
  grep -q "Success! App" /tmp/steam.log && break
done
grep -q "Success! App" /tmp/steam.log || { echo "Steam-Download fehlgeschlagen"; exit 1; }
mkdir -p /mnt/server/FactoryGame/Mods
for p in SML:74YqQBq2KJKN77 ContentLib:FLVJUyAYe74Z3f FreeSamples:8rScR9QHm2eyG AdditionalDepots:F7nkrGuQpJCFVQ FixClientResourceSinkPoints:A6aNVHct3GwgJo HoverpackFuseReminder:4SNESHnHk1ib84 Archipelago:7z3iqZPiB94hb9; do
  n=${p%%:*}; id=${p##*:}
  echo "Mod $n"
  rm -rf "/mnt/server/FactoryGame/Mods/$n" "/mnt/server/FactoryGame/Mods/GameFeatures/$n"
  curl -sSL -o "/tmp/$n.zip" "https://api.ficsit.app/v1/version/$id/WindowsServer/download" || exit 1
  unzip -qo "/tmp/$n.zip" -d "/mnt/server/FactoryGame/Mods/$n" || exit 1
  # GameFeature-Mods (Archipelago, AdditionalDepots) muessen unter Mods/GameFeatures liegen, sonst fehlen ihre Inhalte
  if grep -q '"GameFeature": *true' "/mnt/server/FactoryGame/Mods/$n/$n.uplugin"; then
    mkdir -p /mnt/server/FactoryGame/Mods/GameFeatures
    mv "/mnt/server/FactoryGame/Mods/$n" "/mnt/server/FactoryGame/Mods/GameFeatures/$n"
  fi
done
echo "Installation fertig"
